info.title: MultiMind API
info.description: Supported MultiMind HTTP API: chat and generation, sessions, compliance checks that do not invent a pass, governance artifacts (audit, costs, inventory, guardrails), and the OpenAI-compatible guard proxy. Set API_KEYS to require an X-API-Key header.
